## Outcome

<!-- Describe observable behavior, not implementation activity. -->

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The requested behavior and important failure cases are covered.
- [ ] Existing behavior that must remain unchanged is named and verified.

## Risk and rollback

<!-- Low/medium/high. Call out data, auth, sync, privacy, migration, and UI risk. -->

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] User workflow changes have browser coverage.
- [ ] Material visual changes include intentional snapshot updates.
- [ ] Documentation or an ADR was updated when required.

## Independent review

<!-- Link or summarize review by an agent that did not implement the change. -->

- [ ] Reviewer checked the requirement, diff, architecture boundaries, and tests.
- [ ] Reviewer attempted counterexamples rather than relying on author claims.
